topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I spent every night, every waking moment, pouring over the schematics, refining, improving. My invention, my dream, was finally ready to change the world. But then, I found out. Someone else, someone who didn’t toil for months, years even, has their name on the patent. Their name, not mine. How convenient, how timely, for them to have this ready just as I’m stepping into the light. I’ve got the original ideas, the genuine innovation, and yet, it’s their name that’s protected, their future that’s secured. I should be out there, not just dreaming about the impact I could make. Now, I have to rethink everything, start from scratch, all because someone was—what?—faster? Smarter? Luckier?
